//: RUN THIS AGAINST A TREE WITH SOMETHING OWED, or every deny case fails for the wrong reason. Stage a change to a file your verify.yaml has a rule for, do NOT run the owed check, then: game_loop guardtest --fixture .game_loop/../templates/guardtest/commit-gate.json  — on a clean tree nothing is owed, allowing is CORRECT, and this fixture cannot tell that from a dead gate.
//why: game_loop releases between PR #113 (7814c3d) and the fix (4a9aa38) parse a shell redirection as a pathspec. A pathspec matching nothing empties the commit scope, verify correctly reports nothing owed, and a stale commit is allowed. It fails GREEN: the gate runs, says nothing, and every commit lands. The `2>&1` case below is the one that catches it.

cases.name: a commit carrying an unverified change is REFUSED
...and STILL refused when the command redirects — this is the #113 regression, and the form output is usually captured in
...and still refused when it is also piped, which is how a probe usually gets read
an ordinary read passes untouched, so a guard that refuses everything does not pass this file
